note: City campground in Clearbrook, west of Bemidji. East-side sites E1-E12 in a loop by a small pond; tent camping in open areas on the west side. --Claude
summary: City page and 2026 info sheet read: $25 RV / $10 tent (2026 sheet), 15 full-hookup sites (30A, five 50A), showers, first come with check-in at City Hall. Fees now dated 2026; phone missing.
flags: PHONE missing: City Office 218-776-3213 (city page 'contact the City Office at 218-776-3213'; same on the 2026 sheet and Google). Suggest 218-776-3213.
WEBSITE OK (city page; the short form https://www.ci.clearbrook.mn.us/park-campground is the same page).

LONG-STAY (minor): weekly $150 and monthly $450 rates are posted, but the city page and sheet sell daily sites first come with no seasonal-lease wording; not a long-stay park on what was read. Google 3.9 stars / 16 reviews (local, for the record).

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. Imagery shows the east loop (pin 47.69698,-95.42782) beside a small pond (about 100 m across) 20-40 m from the nearest pads, and a narrow creek west of the park road. A pond this size is no lake value, and no source names a water view; no change.
Season: neither page states one; none written.
Note: dropped '15 RV sites with water, sewer and 50-amp electric' (sites/hookups hold it) and '15 tent sites' (the city says tent sites are 'in open areas' on the west side, no count).
